notes.title: Update: Build 7651751
notes.content:
Thank you for enrolling in the beta test for Botland Chronicles. At the moment, the game is very limited with new updates to arrive as features are completed.

Right now you can:

 Join a singleplayer game
     Move, jump, shoot, test powerups (under development)
 Start a public multiplayer lobby
 Start a private multiplayer lobby
 Start a friends-only multiplayer lobby
 Invite to multiplayer lobby
 Join a multiplayer lobby
 Chat in a multiplayer lobby


The settings button currently does not work.

Controls for certain menus are limited to either mouse or keyboard or both. This was due to the building process and eventually you will be able to navigate all menus with either mouse, keyboard or controller.

The multiplayer lobby menu is still being worked on. You may see debugging code and some buttons may not behave properly. 

Also, while you can technically start a multiplayer game, the other player is currently not visible to you.

Priorities right now are to finish the lobby menus, enable actual co-op play, finish player state machines, begin working on enemies and then start building the game out.
